intro.h2: The quality stays long after the price is forgotten
paragraphs: DG Home Improvement LLC takes on kitchen remodeling Philadelphia homeowners call when they want it done right the first time, or fixed after someone else got it wrong. One client hired Dennis and Kirill to correct issues left by previous contractors, then transform her kitchen and several other rooms. She says her home finally feels complete.

That is the company's whole pitch. You might find someone who will do the job for less, but Dennis would rather be the crew that does not cut corners. Reviewers keep using the same words: honest, detail-oriented, well organized. The work ranges from white shaker kitchens with quartz counters to tub-to-shower bathrooms and new decks.

about.h2: Meet Dennis and the DG crew
about.text: DG Home Improvement LLC is a Pennsylvania remodeling company run by Dennis, whose name and number are on the company's posts and in its reviews. Kirill works alongside him on site. The crew handles kitchens, bathrooms, decks, balconies and demolition, and also offers special pricing to investors and construction companies. The company describes itself as fully insured and OSHA safety trained. Its motto says it all: the quality will remain long after the price is forgotten. Some of its recent finished projects were for returning customers.

items.name: Victoria K.
items.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Outstanding experience from start to finish with DG Home Improvement. Dennis and Kirill did an amazing job correcting issues left by previous contractors and transforming our kitchen and several other rooms. They were professional, reliable, detail-oriented, and genuinely cared about the quality of their work.

What I appreciated most was their honesty and commitment to getting everything done right rather than taking shortcuts. The final result exceeded my expectations, and my home finally feels complete.

Highly recommend this company to anyone looking for quality craftsmanship and trustworthy professionals. Thank you, Dennis and Kirill!

items.name: Vadim P.
items.text: We used DG Home Improvement for remodeling our bathroom by installing the shower in place of the old bathtub. The team made outstanding job. We are highly impressed with their professionalism and the quality of our new bathroom. Our neighbors were also impressed by design of our remodeled bathroom. Great quality, great team to work with. Thank you!

items.name: Kirill
items.text:
We had a great experience working with Denis and his team on our balcony and deck project. From the very beginning, they demonstrated a highly professional approach in every aspect of the work. The project started with a quick and efficient demolition, and throughout the process the team handled several challenges with professionalism and clear expertise.

What stood out most was their attention to detail and commitment to doing the job correctly without cutting corners. Communication was clear, the work was well organized, and the quality of craftsmanship was evident at every stage of the project.

The final result truly speaks for itself — the balcony and deck turned out beautifully and exceeded our expectations. We are extremely pleased with the outcome and would highly recommend Dennis and his team to anyone looking for a contractor who takes pride in their work and delivers high-quality results with a professional approach.

service_area.text: DG Home Improvement LLC is a Pennsylvania company with a Philadelphia phone number and email. Google does not list a street address or a set service area, so the quickest way to check is to call Dennis at (267) 423-2617 with your neighborhood or town. Outdoor jobs like decks are booked ahead of the season, so call early if you want one finished this year.

items.q: Can you fix work another contractor left behind?
items.a: Yes. One client hired DG Home Improvement to correct issues left by previous contractors, then remodel her kitchen and several other rooms. She praised the crew's honesty and commitment to getting everything right rather than taking shortcuts. Call Dennis and describe what was left unfinished.

items.q: Can you turn my bathtub into a walk-in shower?
items.a: Yes. One family had DG Home Improvement remove their old bathtub and install a shower in its place. They were highly impressed with the quality, and their neighbors liked the design too. Bathroom remodels are the job clients mention most often in Google reviews.

DG Home Improvement LLC states that it is fully insured and that its team is OSHA safety trained. Ask Dennis for the insurance certificate when you get your quote, so you have it on file before work starts on your kitchen, bathroom or deck.

items.q: Should my deck be pressure-treated wood or composite?
items.a: Dennis gets this question a lot and regularly posts about the choice between pressure-treated wood and composite. Call (267) 423-2617 to talk through your deck or balcony, what you want from it and how you plan to use it, and ask about sealing an existing deck before summer.

items.q: Do you work with investors or builders?
items.a: Yes. DG Home Improvement offers special pricing for investors and construction companies, and some of its recent finished projects were for returning customers. Call Dennis at (267) 423-2617 for details on rental, multi-unit or repeat renovation work in the Philadelphia area and how scheduling works.
